architecture.mechanism: Condition Monitoring of Wind Turbine Planetary Gearboxes Under Different Operating Conditions
architecture.intervention: Implementation of a condition monitoring system to detect lubrication issues in the planetary gearboxes
architecture.expected_effect: Improved detection of lubrication problems, reducing the risk of failure
architecture.falsification_test: Regular inspection and analysis of lubrication parameters (e.g., viscosity, temperature, pressure) using sensors and data analytics
